listingIdentity.basis: Candidate id, exact title, merchant, offer and source are present in the tracked normalized SerpApi receipt.

exactVariant.basis: No trusted structured variant record was retained; title prose is not promoted.

exactShade.basis: No trusted structured shade record was retained; title prose is not promoted.

finish.basis: No trusted structured finish record was retained; title prose is not promoted.

sourceImage.method: Dominant saturated color of the merchant product image (background pixels excluded); an estimate, not a lab match.
sourceImage.basis: The legacy bundle retained an estimate and coverage, but not the fetched input bytes, input hash, or actual request record.

sameFaceRender.basis: Tracked output plus task id and poll count exist; candidate request and lifecycle response were not retained, so this is not a receipted lifecycle.

systemExclusionReason: System excluded — 2.5% usable shade coverage is below the disclosed 10% heuristic floor.
